summary: To a narrow ideal class of a real quadratic field the paper attaches a hyperbolic surface bounded by the modular closed geodesic, with area πℓ_A. It proves equidistribution of these surfaces over a genus (Theorem 2) through extended Hecke and Katok–Sarnak formulas (Theorems 3–4). Complete (cc-442dc5): every numbered statement and cited input is an item, every missing item is routed, and sixteen findings are recorded. E6 (the normalization of (6.6)) now affects a stated result; Theorem 2 is unaffected. Supplier proofs (gates S1–S8) are deferred. Not formalised.
